events.credibility_reason: Withdrawn by the author because the main proof was wrong (second-hand report).
Withdrawn by the author for a crucial error identified by Schicho.
Claimed landmark (three proofs) in math.GM with no engagement over ~13 years; all later work, including specialists, treats the conjecture as open and does not rely on it.
Withdrawn after Tsimerman found an irreparable error.
Claimed full proof with no uptake over ~9 years, a withdrawn version and six revisions, and later specialist work treating the conjecture as open without citing it.
Several earlier versions carrying a full-proof claim were withdrawn without stated reasons; the surviving partial results have no engagement.

why: Ghosh's arXiv:2501.09272 (Jan 2025) states Theorem A for every characteristic-0 field and every degree, so its scope is whole; the reduction to algebraically closed fields looks routine. It stays unreviewed: the Schaub–Spivakovsky 'Added in press' note says the proof is complete but describes no checking. Spivakovsky read drafts in private, which the paper's acknowledgement records, and that is not a public verification. Marashdeh (Aug 2026) says the proof has not been independently verified. Calling it credible rather than doubtful was the close call. No specific error has been found, the method is serious and a specialist endorses it. The run of earlier withdrawn claims is history about other papers. Ghosh's 2024 dimension bound (at most 2, where 1 is needed) is a bound. Marashdeh's paper rules out counterexamples with fewer than three recycled roots and with two-element support. That settles the conjecture for a restricted class of polynomials, so I scored it as a case. The Schaub–Spivakovsky conditional bad-prime bound, the endorsement note, the talk and the news item settle nothing, so they are scored none. Before the snapshot: the withdrawn proofs are knocked down; Fernandez de las Heras and Lu are not credible (long silence, a landmark claim, later work treating the conjecture as open, withdrawn or revised history); Graf von Bothmer et al. is a digested case. No AI system is credited in any event.
doubts: Ghosh v2 (Mar 2026, 'Major revisions') was not fully read. An unconfirmed paraphrase says one step 'works only over C'. If that is true, the scope narrows to case. Whether Spivakovsky's careful reading of the drafts amounts to digestion is arguable under F9. I left it unreviewed because nothing public describes that check. Castryck et al.'s journal publication was not confirmed. Marashdeh's results scored as case is a judgement call; the alternative reading is none (obstructions only).
